CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.
   C. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.

2. Best practice when working on Painting and Montage: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Painting and Montage with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Painting and Montage.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Painting and Montage.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Painting and Montage.

3. Best practice when working on Photography: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Photography.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Photography.
   C. Damage equipment used for Photography.
   D. Practise Photography with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   C. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   D. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. Best practice when working on Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Songs.
   B. Practise Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Songs.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Songs.

6. Best practice when working on Percussion Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Percussion Musical Instruments.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Percussion Musical Instruments.
   C. Practise Percussion Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Percussion Musical Instruments.

7. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The speed of the music
   B. Only the costume
   C. The ticket price
   D. Only the volume

8. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Guarantee a trophy
   B. Replace drinking water
   C. Remove the need for rules
   D. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

9. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Brown, pink, and gold
   C. Red, blue, and yellow
   D. Black, white, and grey

10. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Swimming.
   B. Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Swimming.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Swimming.

11. Best practice when working on Netball: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Netball.
   B. Practise Netball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Netball.
   D. Damage equipment used for Netball.

12. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Games: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Games.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Games.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Games.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Gymnastics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Songs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Photography and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Descant Recorder and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
